name: 11133-mtpcodegen-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16. Not substitutable: a model whose layers are all full attention never runs the path this setup is about, and the multi-token-prediction head ships in this same repository, so there is no second draft model to choose.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, half of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism and no DP attention.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM: 48 layers, 12 full attention and 36 gated-DeltaNet linear attention; sparse MoE, 512 experts at top-10; 80B parameters, ~3B active per token, ~160 GB of weights and ~40 GB per card at TP4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 160 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `huggingface` data over `openai/openai_humaneval` (name openai_humaneval, split test, 164 rows), single turn, no shared prefix and no multi-turn history. Each request is one HumanEval `prompt` column, a Python function signature and its docstring of roughly 60-300 tokens, and generates exactly 512 tokens under `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`. The 160-request bound is under the dataset's 164 rows so no prompt is served twice. Seed 11133.
purpose: An 80B Python coding assistant writing 512-token completions from short docstring prompts, one at a time, on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang `serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. The reader is flat -- an indented block
# is skipped silently, so a re-flowed structured value drops the key and the engine starts
# without it at rc=0.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 4

# Multi-token prediction with the checkpoint's own draft head. `NEXTN` is argparse
# prefix-matching for the canonical field name and is normalised to EAGLE in server_args.py.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Backend for the 12 full-attention layers; on SM90 this is also what the engine would pick for
# itself. The 36 linear-attention layers are routed to the gated-DeltaNet path regardless.
attention-backend: fa3

# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit heuristic, which derives a different KV pool per
# process from whatever is free -- and a different pool is a different scheduler.
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

random-seed: 11133
